title: Efficient Cross-View Localization in 6G Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network
abstract: arXiv:2603.11398v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recently, visual localization has become an important supplement to improve localization reliability, and cross-view approaches can greatly enhance coverage and adaptability. Meanwhile, future 6G will enable a globally covered mobile communication system, with a space-air-ground integrated network (SAGIN) serving as key supporting architecture. translated_title: 6G空天地一体化网络中的高效跨视角定位
translated_abstract: 近年来，视觉定位已成为提升定位可靠性的重要补充手段，而跨视角方法能够极大增强覆盖范围与适应性。与此同时，未来的6G将实现全球覆盖的移动通信系统，空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）是其关键支撑架构。受此启发，我们探索了跨视角定位（CVL）与6G SAGIN的融合，从而在时延、能耗和隐私保护方面提升其性能。首先，我们对CVL和SAGIN进行了全面综述，重点阐述了两者的能力、融合机遇以及潜在应用。得益于6G SAGIN架构快速且广泛的图像采集与传输能力，CVL实现了更高的定位精度和更快的处理速度。随后，我们提出了一种用于实现CVL的分割推理框架，该框架充分利用了……
tldr: 本文首次将跨视角定位与6G空天地一体化网络相融合，并提出一种分割推理框架，在降低时延、能耗和增强隐私保护的同时，实现了更高的定位精度与更快的处理速度。
en_tdlr: This paper integrates cross-view localization with 6G space-air-ground integrated networks and proposes a split-inference framework, achieving higher localization accuracy and faster processing speed while reducing latency, energy consumption, and enhancing privacy protection.
